home_intro: Create a wishlist for your child, share it with family and friends, and avoid duplicate gifts.
home_field_email_hint: We'll send you the admin and guest links. No account needed.
home_field_key_hint: This key encrypts your wishlist data. It will be included in the share links by default.
home_parents_1: Create a wishlist above (optionally set a custom encryption key).
home_parents_2: You land on the admin page — bookmark this link. It contains your admin token and, by default, the encryption key.
home_parents_3: Add wishes with a name, price hint, shop links, and description.
home_parents_4: Copy the guest link and send it to family and friends, or open Share / QR Code to print a handout.
home_parents_5: On the admin page you can choose whether links include the encryption key. If you share links without the key, recipients must enter it on an unlock screen.
home_parents_6: When the occasion is over, mark the list as done (the guest link stops working) or delete it entirely.
home_parents_key_note: Save your encryption key if you plan to share links without the key in the URL. The key is not stored in the database and cannot be recovered from it.
home_guests_1: Open the guest link you received (from email, chat, or QR code).
home_guests_2: If the link has no key, enter the encryption key you were given separately.
home_guests_3: Enter your name once at the top of the page.
home_guests_4: Click "I'll buy this!" on any item you plan to purchase. You can undo a reservation within 60 seconds.
home_privacy_note: No accounts needed. Your wishlist is protected by secret links. All data is automatically deleted after 18 months.
home_encryption_note: All wishlist content is encrypted in the database. The encryption key is included in links by default — save it if you share links without the key.
unlock_intro: This wishlist is encrypted. Enter the encryption key to view it.
unlock_key_hint: You received this key when the wishlist was created, or it was included in the link.
admin_encryption_key_hint: Share this key separately when links do not include it. Guests need it to unlock the list.
admin_key_reveal_text: Your wishlist was upgraded to encrypted storage. Save this key — you will need it to access the list if the link does not include it.
admin_key_reveal_hint: Links on this page include the key by default. Uncheck the option below to share links without the key.
admin_subtitle: Admin view — keep this link private!
admin_expires_on: This wishlist will be automatically deleted on
admin_show_buyers: Show buyer names to all guests
admin_show_buyers_hint: When enabled, guests can see who reserved each wish instead of just "Already planned by someone".
admin_finish_text: When you're done with this wishlist, mark it as complete. The guest link will stop working.
admin_delete_confirm: Are you sure? This will permanently delete the wishlist and all its wishes.
admin_done_message: This wishlist has been marked as done.
admin_done_text: The guest link is no longer active. Thank you for using Wishlist!
guest_intro: Enter your name below, then click the button on any wish you'd like to buy.
guest_no_items: No wishes on this wishlist yet. Check back later!
error_unavailable: This wishlist is no longer available.
site_admin_cleanup_active: Active wishlists older than {days} days ({months} months)
site_admin_cleanup_done: Done wishlists marked as done more than {days} days ago
site_admin_cleanup_confirm: Run cleanup now? This will permanently delete expired wishlists.
share_additional_placeholder: e.g. Emma's birthday party is on Saturday, June 14th at 3pm...
share_include_key_in_qr: Include encryption key in QR code / link
privacy_intro: This app does not use tracking or advertising cookies. Below is what is stored in your browser and on the server.
privacy_cookies_intro: The app sets a small number of cookies in your browser:
privacy_cookie_lang: Stores your language preference (English or German). Set when you change the language. Duration: 1 year.
privacy_cookie_admin: Session cookie for the site administrator dashboard only (/admin). Set when an administrator logs in. HttpOnly, duration: 24 hours. Not used for wishlists.
privacy_storage_intro: These values stay in your browser and are not sent to the server automatically:
privacy_storage_guest_name: The guest name you enter on a wishlist page, so you do not have to type it again on your device.
privacy_storage_scroll: Temporary scroll position on the admin page while editing (sessionStorage, cleared after reload).
privacy_db_intro: Wishlist data is stored in a SQLite database on the server. Sensitive text fields are encrypted before storage (AES-256-GCM). Only a hash of the encryption key is stored — not the key itself.
privacy_db_wishlists: Encrypted title and optional parent email; secret admin and guest link tokens; hash of the encryption key; creation/update dates; settings (e.g. whether buyer names are visible to guests).
privacy_db_items: Encrypted name, description, shop links, and price hint; sort order; creation date; soft-delete timestamp if removed.
privacy_db_reservations: Encrypted guest name for each reservation; creation date; soft-delete timestamp if undone or removed.
privacy_db_stats: Anonymous aggregate counts only (e.g. number of deleted wishlists). No wishlist content.
privacy_db_encrypted: Encrypted fields are unreadable in the database without the encryption key, which is passed in the link or entered manually.
privacy_not_stored_key: The encryption key itself (only a hash is kept for verification).
privacy_not_stored_accounts: No user accounts, passwords, or login profiles for parents or guests.
privacy_not_stored_tracking: No analytics, advertising, or third-party tracking.
privacy_retention_text: Active wishlists are automatically deleted after {days} days. Wishlists marked as done are deleted {done_days} days after completion.
